definitions.gloss: (of food) falling apart or losing shape while simmering
definitions.explanation: When potatoes, pumpkin, fish or tofu break up and lose their shape because they were simmered too long or too hard.

examples.japanese: ⟦じゃがいも→じゃがいも：05184_jagaimo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{煮崩|にくず}れ⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The potatoes fell apart in the pot.

examples.japanese: {煮崩|にくず}れしにくい⟦かぼちゃ→かぼちゃ：10306_kabocha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: I choose a pumpkin that won't fall apart when simmered.

examples.japanese: ⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{煮|に}る→煮る：01971_niru⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{煮崩|にくず}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{煮汁|にじる}→煮汁：20628_nijiru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{沸|わ}いて→沸く：01122_waku⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: When simmering fish, put it in after the broth comes to a boil so it doesn't fall apart.

notes:
Usually used as {煮崩|にくず}れ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧, or in recipe advice such as {煮崩|にくず}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧ and {煮崩|にくず}れしにくい.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {煮崩|にくず}れ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to fall apart while simmering
- {煮崩|にくず}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧: to keep food from falling apart
- {煮崩|にくず}れしにくい: holds its shape when simmered

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{煮|に}る→煮る：01971_niru⟧: to simmer, to boil
- ⟦{崩|くず}れる→崩れる：04248_kuzureru⟧: to crumble, to collapse
